title: a new dependency: a bare import, a manifest or dependency line, an unpinned vendored file

explain.what: The branch adds a dependency: an import of an outside package, a change to a manifest or lock file, or a vendored file with no row in VENDOR.md.
explain.why: Each dependency is code we did not write and must trust, update and ship. Norn keeps to Node built-ins unless the owner approves an addition.
explain.fix: Use a Node built-in or write the small piece yourself. If the dependency is needed, ask the owner; the approval is the waiver. Give a vendored file its row in VENDOR.md.

base.src/a.mjs:
import fs from 'node:fs';
export const a = fs;

import fs from 'node:fs';
export const a = fs;

head.web/vendor/lib.js:
import three from 'three';
export default three;
